calibration.high_vs_medium_conviction: Not enough independent signals to compare conviction levels (need 30 each).

notes: Point-in-time: XBRL facts filtered by filing date, as first reported; prices truncated at each decision date.
News, social and event-calendar inputs are unavailable historically and are missing (not zero) in these scores.
Forward returns overlap across weekly decision dates: treat n_obs as an upper bound on independent evidence.
Universe: 48 stocks currently in the watchlist/ranked set (survivorship bias: names were chosen today).
Simulation: every 15 trading days, equal-weight top quintile, entered at the NEXT close, held 15 days, 30 bps round-trip cost; no stops/targets (ranking test, not the live entry/stop rules).
Uncertainty: moving-block bootstrap over decision dates (block = 3 dates) to respect overlapping windows.

evidence.banner: Matured live outcomes exist but the CI of the hit rate vs QQQ includes 50%. The tool has not demonstrated predictive value.
